description: This file defines the User entity class for a Java application using JPA annotations. It models an application user with fields like id, name, email, passwordHash, and createdAt, along with constructors, getters, setters, and overridden equals and hashCode methods.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents an application user with fields for id, name, email, password hash, and creation timestamp, mapping to the 'users' table in a database.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing name, email, and passwordHash.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email of the user.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email of the user.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the user was created.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on user id.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the user object.
